lines.text: Joshua builds an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal.
Following the Book of the Law, Joshua builds the altar of uncut stones, and they offer burnt offerings and peace offerings.
In front of the Israelites, Joshua inscribes on the stones a copy of the law of Moses.
All Israel stands on both sides of the ark, half in front of Mount Sinai and half in front of Mount Ebal.
Joshua reads all the words of the law, blessings and curses, before the whole assembly, including the women and the kings.
